description: This Java source file defines the AddressAuthzHelper class, which provides utility methods to handle AMQP address authorization capabilities in the Eclipse Hono project. It manages processing AMQP connection properties related to user authorities, checking client capabilities, and version compatibility.

classes.name: AddressAuthzHelper
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for managing AMQP address authorization features, including capability checking, processing connection properties, and version parsing.

methods.name: isAddressAuthzCapabilitySet
methods.description: Checks if the remote AMQP connection has indicated support for ADDRESS-AUTHZ in its desired capabilities.

methods.name: processAddressAuthzCapability
methods.description: Processes a peer’s AMQP open frame, setting connection properties with authorities, and offering the ADDRESS-AUTHZ capability.

methods.name: isLegacyClient
methods.description: Determines if a client connection is considered legacy based on its version string.

methods.name: parseVersionString
methods.description: Parses a version string (e.g., '1.4.2') into its major, minor, and patch components.

methods.name: getPermissionsFromAuthorities
methods.description: Converts Authorities object to a map of resource types to permission arrays.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Converts a string of activity characters ('R', 'W') into an array of permission strings ('recv', 'send').
